Type: metal frame wall shelf
Use: displaying small decor, books and plants; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, industrial, minimalist
Materials: thin gold-finished metal frame, wood shelf board
Colors: antique gold, warm natural wood
Shape: open rectangular wire frame with one suspended wooden shelf, top rail with keyhole hangers, slim lines, light and airy
Feel: airy, warm, understated
Goes with: brass and wood accents, white or neutral walls; modern, industrial or minimalist rooms

product.name: Rivet Modern Floating Wall Mounted Shelving Decor - 9 Inch, Natural Wood and Gold (Renewed)
product.description: This wall unit offers a modern take on shelving with a single shelf held up by a crisscrossing, triangular iron frame. The rubberwood veneer gives this unit a convincing natural look, and the gold-colored iron provides a sense of luxury. 9.06"H x 24.6"W x 5.91"D 60% MDF with rubberwood veneer; 40% iron Shelf unit Avoid moisture. This item wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware is included.
